## Device Info

- Device: _example `RK918`_
- MCU Label: _example `HFD2201KBA`_
- Rebrand MCU: _example SN32F248B_
- PCB Model: _example `130-91801-01`
- PCB Date: _example `10/29/2018`

## USB Info

_You can use UsbTreeView to check this_

- Vendor ID: _example `0c45`
- Product ID: _example `8006`
- USB Vendor: _example `SONiX`
- USB Description: _example `USB DEVICE`

## Images of PCB

_If possible, include photos of your keyboard's PCB clearly showing MCU and other ICs_
